question: Which fixed-panel RNA components associate with detected cargo within each other tissue?
decision: Assess the tissue boundary for cargo association and retain tissue-specific or absent directions.
strongest_rival: Preferential uptake by an existing macrophage subset can create the observed cargo-status association.
discriminator: Pair cargo-positive and negative within tissue and the same preparation. The design cannot discriminate induction from selection.
exposure_record: A-Gonzalez article and data design were reviewed. Fixed-panel outcomes from the released matrix were unopened when specified.
biological_unit: Within-tissue mouse pool with sorted positive and negative fractions.
nesting_and_overlap: Nine tissue-specific pool pairs across two library batches. Cross-tissue mouse overlap unresolved.
population_and_selection: Macrophages isolated from spleen, bone marrow and large intestine of parabiotic mice with or without detectable transferred cargo.
contrast: Cargo-positive minus cargo-negative within each matched pair in each tissue.
endpoint: Paired log2(CPM+1) difference in deposited TMM-normalized gene abundance.
methods: Exact stable Ensembl gene ID join and mean paired difference by tissue, with pair directions retained.
missingness_and_exclusions: Keep absent and ambiguous genes as missing. Do not substitute unmatched sample pairs.
multiplicity: Fixed paper-derived panels, fully reported without significance tests.
precision_basis: Three pairs per tissue with descriptive directions and no population-level tests.
interpretation_limit: This dataset quantifies association with detectable partner cargo and cannot identify within-cell induction.
stop_rule: Hold a tissue if its library pairing is unverifiable and hold a gene if its ID is missing or duplicated.
amendment_reason: Initial descriptive replay of the verified revised plan using the deposited TPM scale.
